suspected_cause_hypothesis: Atypical drought / severe agro-climatic deficit in late Kharif season not captured by static geographic features.
agricultural_consequence: Severe underestimation of crop failure leads to deficit in regional grain reserve planning and delayed emergency relief allocation.
proposed_mitigation: Incorporate satellite vegetation indices (NDVI/EVI) and mid-season precipitation anomalies as dynamic covariates.

suspected_cause_hypothesis: Intensive canal-irrigated high-yielding variety (HYV) pocket with intensive NPK application outperforming district mean baseline.
agricultural_consequence: Underestimation of regional surplus leads to local market storage bottlenecks and procurement under-capacity.
proposed_mitigation: Ingest micro-irrigation percentage and seed replacement rate at sub-district / taluk resolution.

suspected_cause_hypothesis: Localized pest infestation / blast disease outbreak leading to premature lodging in lowland rice belt.
agricultural_consequence: Overestimation of harvest yields results in misallocated procurement logistics and unhedged farmer credit defaults.
proposed_mitigation: Integrate pest-surveillance early warning alerts and crop health telemetry into pre-harvest adjustments.

suspected_cause_hypothesis: Extreme flood inundation causing partial harvest abandonment in riverine delta district.
agricultural_consequence: Overestimation of harvest causes failure to trigger timely crop insurance payouts (PMFBY).
proposed_mitigation: Fuse synthetic aperture radar (SAR) flood extent inundation masks to discount harvestable acreage.

suspected_cause_hypothesis: High agro-ecological variance across tribal/hilly tracts within the district boundary masking localized yield disparities.
agricultural_consequence: Sub-optimal localized fertilizer distribution quotas based on aggregated district projections.
proposed_mitigation: Refine spatial resolution to block/mandal granularity and incorporate agro-ecological zone (AEZ) stratification.
